valuation_methodology.owner_cash_definition: Sweetwater attributable adjusted EBITDA less cash interest and maintenance-like owner costs; uranium royalties and inventory treated as options outside trough base cash
valuation_methodology.decision_rule: Keep producing trona royalty cash, surface/easement cash, land/uranium options, and net debt separate. Do not average operating return with optionality NAV.

inputs.price_source: Yahoo UROY last 2026-07-27; 1:1 exchange into New URC — use as listing proxy until New URC tape prints
inputs.shares_source: Circular selected pro forma weighted average shares after Arrangement (basic) 361,037,249
inputs.fcf_source: [Assumption] Near-trough owner cash after interest: ~US$18m attributable mid/trough blend / 361m shares. Interest coverage ~1.1x on 9mo annualized operating income — FCF thin until soda ash recovers.
inputs.net_debt_source: Pro forma cash C$16.452m and LTD C$859.020m at Jan 31 2026; FX from US$625m Sweetwater debt / C$859.020m
inputs.normalization_note: Soda ash at generational lows (NRP/Sisecam commentary). FY2025 Sweetwater royalty revenue US$59.3m vs prior US$82.5m. Base does not capitalize +60% operator capacity until volumes show up.

optionality_gate.trigger: Land/royalty estate with GAAP that understates perpetual mineral rights; uranium portfolio is call-option stack; deal creates US domestic listing / PFIC exit for new buyers
optionality_gate.catalyst: NASDAQ listing of New URC ~2026-07-28; soda ash cycle rebalance multi-year; uranium royalty funding from trona cash

bear.notes: Soda ash stays oversupplied 5+ years; attributable EBITDA ~US$46m; 15x exit still leaves thin equity stub after US$613m net debt; forced financing risk

base.notes: Midcycle attributable EBITDA recovers toward ~US$68m (92% of US$74m 2yr avg); market pays 18x EV/EBITDA; land/uranium options partially recognized but not fully TPL-ized

bull.notes: Operator +60% capacity lands in royalty volumes; soda ash normalizes; uranium royalties and Wyoming land options re-rate; leverage works for equity

component_valuation.methodology_note: Scarce-strategic-asset engines: capital-free trona royalties, surface/easement cash, residual land inventory, uranium royalty/physical options, minus net debt and 8% Sweetwater NCI.

components.label: Producing Green River trona / soda ash royalties (92%)

valuation.evidence: Sweetwater adj. EBITDA US$66.2m / US$80.8m (circular); PR avg ~US$74m last 2 FY on 100% basis. Attributable 92%. Multiples: low 15x trough US$46m; base 18x midcycle US$68.1m; high 18x expansion US$108.9m.
valuation.cross_check: Paradigm fairness EV/CY EBITDA 17-23x and EV/CY+1 13-19x (circular). Lemon Cakes fair band 15-20x. Deal prints ~26-32x on those anchors at deemed US$3.64.
valuation.assumption_summary: Natural trona cost advantage vs synthetic soda ash; soft price ceiling from synthetic supply; checkerboard KSLA means ~half basin production historically.

components.label: Surface, lease bonus, easement, and access cash

valuation.evidence: Pro forma FY2025 lease bonus C$7.1m + surface C$2.7m (~US$7.2m combined at debt-implied FX). Already inside Sweetwater adjusted EBITDA used for the producing royalty multiple.
valuation.cross_check: Embedded — do not add again when summing enterprise value.
valuation.assumption_summary: Diagnostic range only; parent is trona_royalties_producing.

components.label: Residual fee surface + mineral acres outside producing trona run-rate

valuation.evidence: ~850k fee surface acres; ~4.5m mineral acres; ~300k acres under renewable leases (deal PR). No oil & gas rights emphasized. Data-center / ranching / renewables are aspirational.
valuation.cross_check: TPL rhyme is structural (rail-grant checkerboard) not commodity. Synthetic soda ash caps mineral inelasticity vs TPL oil.
valuation.assumption_summary: [Assumption] Wide range until acre-level comps and water-right facts are mapped. Keep out of trough base cash.

components.label: Legacy URC uranium royalties, streams, and residual physical U

valuation.evidence: Pre-deal URC was uranium royalty + physical accumulator; ~75% of stockpile sold to fund cash leg (Lemon Cakes / deal funding). Cameco Athabasca royalties + restart exposure remain. Pre-deal equity market ~US$375m at US$2.96 × ~127m shares — not all option value survives dilution into New URC.
valuation.cross_check: Old URC shareholders own ~41% of New URC; uranium expertise is the inorganic growth engine funded by trona cash.
valuation.assumption_summary: Treat as call options on uranium price and project sanctions, not as current owner cash.

components.label: Pro forma net debt + Sweetwater 8% NCI claim

valuation.evidence: Net debt ~US$613m (cash US$12m, debt US$625m). NCI C$134.75m (~US$98m) for ~8% Sweetwater. Thin cash after US$330m seller cash + costs.
valuation.cross_check: Interest coverage ~0.8-1.1x on pro forma operating income — leverage is the equity story.
valuation.assumption_summary: Debt is non-negotiable in equity stub math.

estimates.deal_print_ev_ebitda_approx: 26x-32x at deemed US$3.64 depending on EBITDA anchor
estimates.blended_note: At US$2.96 listing proxy, equity is still above midcycle 15-20x stub prices (~US$1.1-2.1) unless expansion EBITDA or land/uranium options are credited. Deemed US$3.64 is deal optics, not a floor.

human_review: Confirm New URC NASDAQ ticker and opening print after 2026-07-28 listing
Map Royalty Notes covenants, amortization, and refinance dates from Sweetwater debt docs
Decide whether surface/easement value is embedded in EBITDA multiple (avoid double count in SOTP sum)
PFIC / tax path for holders who owned UROY/URC through domestication — tax counsel
